title: Cartas: Liberty City Wrath
sum: 24 cartas de futebol americano, com o local de cada uma.
body:
- Futebol americano, 24 cartas. Locais segundo a lista da IGN; marque cada uma ao pegar.
- 1 carta(s) ficam em **cofre**: abra com o código que sai do assalto àquele lugar ou com sticky bomb.
- Volte para [[colecao-cartas]].

en.title: Cards: Liberty City Wrath
en.body:
- Football, 24 cards. Locations from IGN's list; tick each one as you grab it.
- 1 card(s) sit in a **safe**: open it with the code from robbing that place, or a sticky bomb.
- Back to [[colecao-cartas]].

On the side of a corkboard inside the staff hallway through the door behind the treadmills on the third floor of the Ajax Gym on Vickery Dr on Oldby Island
On top of the steps leading up the villa on the U-shaped driveway off of Emory Ave in southwestern Peacock Bay
